info.title: Kora (Korapay) Complete Stateful Mock API — Payments & Identity (KYC/KYB)
info.description:
Interactive OpenAPI 3.0.3 specification for the containerized **Kora (formerly Korapay) Stateful WireMock Server**.

### Key Capabilities
- **Dynamic Stateful Persistence (`wiremock-state-extension`)**: Every `POST` creation endpoint records state indexed by `reference` (or `account_reference` / `batch_reference` / `VR-*`), which can be immediately queried back via the corresponding `GET` endpoint.
- **Finite-State-Machine Scenarios**: Supports `Card-Charge-Lifecycle` (`CARD-SCENARIO-001`), `Payout-Lifecycle` (`PAYOUT-SCENARIO-001`), `Refund-Balance-Lifecycle` (`REFUND-SCENARIO-001`), `Idempotency-Flow` (`IDEMPOTENT-REF-001`), and `Identity-Verification-Lifecycle` (`ID-SCENARIO-001`).
- **Introspected WireMock Stubs**: Generated from `87` active WireMock stub mappings.

### Pre-Configured Authentication
Use Bearer token `sk_test_kora_stateful_mock_2025` (pre-authorized automatically in `/docs`).

servers.description: Local Kora Stateful WireMock Server (Docker / Port 8080)

tags.name: Collections / Pay-ins
tags.description: Initialize checkout charges, bank transfers, mobile money, Pay With Bank, EFT, and query charge status.

tags.name: Card & OTP Scenarios
tags.description: Stateful finite-state-machine card payment lifecycles with OTP challenge (`00000` invalid vs `12345` valid) and idempotency testing.

tags.name: Virtual Bank Accounts
tags.description: Create dedicated virtual bank accounts (VBA), fetch VBA details by reference, list inward transactions, and simulate sandbox credits.

tags.name: Disbursements & Bulk Payouts
tags.description: Single and bulk bank/mobile-money payouts, stateful polling (`PAYOUT-SCENARIO-001`), and bulk batch verification.

tags.name: Refunds
tags.description: Initiate transaction refunds (coupled with merchant balance deduction) and query refund status by reference.

tags.name: Balances & Settlements
tags.description: Retrieve multi-currency merchant wallet balances (`NGN`, `KES`, `GHS`, `USD`), wallet ledger history, and settlements.

tags.name: Verification & FX Utilities
tags.description: List Nigerian banks and African Mobile Money Operators, resolve account names, and execute FX conversions.

tags.name: Identity KYC - Nigeria
tags.description: Verify Nigerian BVN, NIN, vNIN, Phone Number, Bank Account, Driver's License, Voter's Card (PVC), and International Passport.

tags.name: Identity KYB - Business
tags.description: Verify Nigerian Corporate Affairs Commission (CAC) registrations (`RC`, `BN`, `IT`) and Tax Identification Numbers (TIN).

tags.name: Identity KYC - Pan-Africa
tags.description: Verify national identities across Kenya (National ID, KRA PIN, Passport), Ghana (Ghana Card, SSNIT, Voter's Card), and South Africa (Smart ID).

tags.name: Identity Verification Management
tags.description: Retrieve stored KYC/KYB verification records by reference (`VR-*`), list verification history, verify document authenticity, and complete consent scenarios.
